items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: And Dick Allen. Is that the middle name? No, it's Joseph Rennie. That's all. We just always carried two names.

ctx.x: Marjorie Zander. Paul Crawford. Bill Russell.
And Dick Allen. Is that the middle name? No, it's Joseph Rennie. That's all. We just always carried two names. They had a middle one. We wouldn't know nothing about it.
How do you spell Rennie really?
I guess we ought to get everybody's name on here. Go ahead.
Alright. Uh, what would you like to know? Your name. Name, George Rene. Marjorie Zander. And Dick Allen.

Okay, we got everybody's name down. See, we're going to talk some more about the funerals that they, that they had like ones where they made pictures. You said they made pictures? They made moving pictures of your brother?

items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: You know Dick Allen? Yeah, sure. I bet you can get that record from him.

ctx.x: I thought it was kind of difficult to get those records.

I don't know if you can go to Ikes for King René's Delta Giant Band. The Giant Band, you can get it under that name. They got the history and everything. I don't know the record to a fella. I had it here for quite a while. And a fella wanted so bad, so I don't know if I can take it. I ain't gonna use it, just let somebody get it. Sure. You know Dick Allen? Yeah, sure. I bet you can get that record from him.
Oh yeah, he's got copies of them up at the Tulane Library.
